narrative: First light. Gib is on Field's Holinshed, and the book is shut under him. A clean sheet is clear of the cat. No face. The sheet filling with one man and a room. No second character. The cat has not been moved. No face. The same sheet, still one voice. The margin has no groom yet and no music. No face.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Wrote Pomfret, and left the cat where he was.

entities.name: Gib
entities.context: Sat on the shut Holinshed. He has no lines.
